VBO:0201350.summary: Energetic and territorial, the Tibetan Kyi Apso was described by its breed club as keen on running but mellow off duty. Traditionally it guarded homes, monasteries and flocks with a deep warning bark. Daniel Taylor’s later memoir records that his import project ended because some dogs could be ferocious.
VBO:0201350.shortDescription: An energetic Tibetan guardian with a deep warning bark, described by its breed club as mellow when off duty.
